messages:
maria: Heads up — new hire's onboarding sample app fails when they import the npm SDK in Cloudflare Workers. Repro in the onboarding repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboarding-samples/tree/main/sample-worker

devon: Can you paste the exact runtime error they see?

maria: Error from the worker: Uncaught (in worker) TypeError: default is not a constructor. Repro snippet:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: SECRET });
```

aj: That smells like an ESM vs CJS entrypoint mismatch — workers expect native ESM. Could be our published package exports defaulting to CJS.

sophia: Ran a quick check of the tarball we published — package.json only points the exports at the CJS file. Example excerpt (humanized):
```json
{
  'main': './dist/index.cjs.js',
  'module': './dist/index.esm.js',
  'types': './dist/index.d.ts',
  'exports': {
    'default': './dist/index.cjs.js'
  }
}
```

maria: Yep — that explains why Workers (and some edge runtimes) resolve the CJS artifact and then the runtime tries to call it like a constructor. Blocks first-run onboarding which is bad. :frowning: 

devon: The right approach is conditional exports so import/require map correctly and types are visible to TS resolution. Proposal:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/index.esm.js",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This gives bundlers and Node the signals they expect.

aj: Also consider an "edge" subpath for a minimal ESM-only build, e.g. `"./edge": "./dist/index.edge.mjs"` so Cloudflare/Vercel can pick that if consumers configure it.

sophia: If we ship an edge artifact, make sure our build strips optional Node deps (fs, child_process) so it doesn't pull in polyfills. Also add a smoke test that bundles the sample with esbuild and runs it in a local worker runtime in CI.

maria: New hire blocked in onboarding checklist — can we ship a point release patch?

devon: I'll open a PR today with package.json changes + CI smoke test and a short note in the onboarding doc. cc @aj for typesVersions fallback for older TS.

aj: Yes, add a typesVersions block or put types inside exports so tsserver/older TS sees declarations. Otherwise some editors won't pick up intellisense.

ci-bot: buildkite: #2345 passed — note current pipeline doesn't run any worker/edge smoke tests yet.

sophia: One more nit: ensure our published ./dist/index.esm.js has a "default export" shape compatible with `import Redwood from` (i.e., export default createClient). Some bundlers interop differently when package.json has "type": "module" vs not.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/678 — includes exports change, typesVersions tweak, and a Cloudflare worker smoke test. Requesting review.

maria: Thanks — onboarding doc owner will validate the sample once the PR lands.
